Topic labels are based on database queries and title screening, not individual evidence appraisal.
English-language PubMed coverage favors health and psychology; this is not a systematic or exhaustive education literature review.
Citation ranking favors older and widely cited publications.
Publication-type and retraction filtering depend on current source metadata.
The publication cutoff does not mean every record was available in the database on that date.
